tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: If the tenderer is a manufacturer who must have manufactured, tested and supplied the equipment (s) similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements up to 10 numbers in any one of the last 3 years i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25. The equipments offered for supply must satisfy the specifications mentioned in the tender along with recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design. The models should be in satisfactory operation for 2 years as on date of tender opening.

Tenders of tenderers quoting as authorized representative of a manufacturer, meeting with the above requirement in full, can also be considered provided (a) The manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per GCC and SCC and (b) The successful bidder should provide authorized representative for having supplied, installed and commissioned satisfactorily at least 10 numbers of the quantity similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements in any one of the last three years i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 which must be in satisfactory operation.
The bidder has to upload the Firm Registration Certificate / Company Incorporation Certificate.

Self-Declaration stating that the tenderer have not been black listed by any Government Department or Quasi Government. Organizations or Public Undertaking Sectors and will not supply Refurbished materials and is not facing any judicial enquiry.
The bidder has to upload the copy of the PAN Card and GST Registration Certificate and Documents of GST returns paid challan for one years i.e. Jan-2025 to till date to be uploaded.
Technical Specifications should be filled (with make, model no or part no and if any other required details), signed and submitted as per Section - VI.
Printed literature and brochure in English of the quoted model including complete details should be uploaded.
Tender bid offer form Section - VIII document duly filled signed and uploaded by the tenderer.

Proforma statement of the orders up to at least 10 numbers for the primary manufacturer and up to at least 10 numbers for the authorized representative/agent of a manufacturer of the scheduled requirement of the tender for the Passenger Lift in any one of last three years (i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 ) in Section - XII and the Performance Statement / Satisfactory Certificates of the same should be submitted
Income tax returns statements for the last three financial years i.e. i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 should be submitted (income tax return acknowledgement copies).

The average annual financial turnover of the tenderer should be minimum of rupees 02 Crores for each of the three financial years i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 and certified by a chartered accountant, copy of the annual turnover declaration by a chartered accountant to be submitted.
The bidder or his representative must upload the copy of the valid at least Class II electrical contract license
